# Free Certificates (Google, Cloud Basics & More)

_8 offer(s). Part of The Actually-Free Job Training Directory; go [back to the index](../index.md)._

These hand you an actual certificate or digital badge at zero cost — including Google tools and cloud basics from AWS, Cisco, and IBM. These are the 'yes, that line goes on the resume' items. Every free claim here includes the certificate itself.

| [Google Skillshop](#entry-google-skillshop) | Google | 100% free including exams and certificates; any Google account gets in |

<a id="entry-google-skillshop"></a>

### Google Skillshop

**Provider:** Google  
**Link:** <https://skillshop.withgoogle.com>

**What it is:** Google's own training platform: Google Ads certifications, Google Analytics 4 certifications, Google Workspace skills, and AI/ML basics tracks.

**What "free" means:** 100% free including exams and certificates; any Google account gets in. No trial, no card on file.

**Paper trail:** Shareable digital certificates (searchable/recruiter-visible in Google Partner contexts).

**Time needed:** 3-20 hours per certification track

**Honest catch:** Google Ads certifications expire after about a year and must be re-taken free. Training glorifies Google's own tools.

**Tags:** certificate, sign-up, google, cloud-basics, marketing

**Verified free:** 2026-11-08 · re-check due by 2027-01-08

<a id="entry-grow-free-courses"></a>

### Grow with Google Free Courses

**Provider:** Google  
**Link:** <https://grow.google/certificates/free-courses/>

**What it is:** Google's own listing of its no-cost classes: AI essentials, online marketing basics via Google Digital Garage material, and the most-requested career-boosting courses.

**What "free" means:** Free to take, many with a free certificate of completion, hosted by Google directly. Distinct from the paid Google Career Certificates, which run on Coursera behind a paid subscription after a short trial.

**Paper trail:** Free completion certificate on several courses; the flagship Career Certificate itself costs money.

**Time needed:** 1-10 hours per short course

**Honest catch:** Odd to Google for: this listing shifts around. Confirm the certificate icon means a downloadable certificate, not a 'congrats' banner.

**Tags:** certificate, google, sign-up, ai, marketing

**Verified free:** 2026-11-08 · re-check due by 2027-01-08

<a id="entry-cisco-netacad"></a>

### Cisco Networking Academy

**Provider:** Cisco  
**Link:** <https://www.netacad.com/courses>

**What it is:** Cisco's self-paced, entry-level curriculum: networking essentials, cybersecurity, Python, Linux, and the IoT and data-amount basics.

**What "free" means:** Free self-paced courses, with most new content delivered free. Fees generally only appear on the separate CCNA exam.

**Paper trail:** Free completion certificates and/or Credly digital badges on most self-paced courses.

**Time needed:** 10-70 hours per course

**Honest catch:** The big certification (CCNA) costs money. Tutorial style leans long-form academic.

**Tags:** certificate, badge, cloud-basics, sign-up, tech

**Verified free:** 2026-11-08 · re-check due by 2027-01-08

<a id="entry-aws-skillbuilder"></a>

### AWS Skill Builder (free tier)

**Provider:** Amazon Web Services  
**Link:** <https://skillbuilder.aws>

**What it is:** Amazon's official training platform. The free tier holds hundreds of digital courses on cloud basics, machine learning fundamentals, security, and serverless.

**What "free" means:** The digital course library is free with any AWS account. Pro subscription stuff (labs, official exam preps) is paid: the free tier is genuinely courses.

**Paper trail:** Completion tracking in-platform. The formal AWS certification exams (like Certified Cloud Practitioner) cost money.

**Time needed:** 2-30 hours per course

**Honest catch:** No formal certificate on most free courses. Exam vouchers, practice exams, and labs sit behind the paid tiers.

**Tags:** cloud-basics, sign-up, self-paced, tech

**Verified free:** 2026-11-08 · re-check due by 2027-01-08

<a id="entry-ibm-skillsbuild"></a>

### IBM SkillsBuild

**Provider:** IBM  
**Link:** <https://skillsbuild.org>

**What it is:** IBM's free job-track curriculum for adult learners and job seekers: AI, cybersecurity, data analytics, cloud, and soft-skill tracks.

**What "free" means:** 100% free including assessments and digital credentials (via the Credly badge system). Free account required.

**Paper trail:** Free verifiable digital badges/certificates through Credly.

**Time needed:** 5-30 hours per track

**Honest catch:** Badges are not the same as paid IBM certification exams, but they are real, verifiable credentials.

**Tags:** certificate, badge, ai, sign-up, cloud-basics

### Kaggle Learn

**Provider:** Kaggle (Google-owned)  
**Link:** <https://www.kaggle.com/learn>

**What it is:** Short, hands-on AI and data courses run in browser notebooks: Python, pandas, machine learning, data visualization, deep learning intro.

**Paper trail:** Free certificates, verifiable via Kaggle URLs (recruiters do check these).
